items.definition:
a sugar present in milk
Many people are intolerant to lactose.

the exclusion of employees by an employer from their place of work
The dispute led to a factory lockout.

a person who conducts negotiations
She is a skilled negotiator in business deals.

the act of obeying a rule or custom
The observance of safety regulations is crucial in the workplace.

a word, clause, or sentence inserted as an explanation or afterthought into a passage
He added a brief explanation in parenthesis.

a compound containing an oxygen-oxygen single bond
She used hydrogen peroxide to clean the wound.

a small, short-tailed game bird
We saw a covey of quail in the field.

a peculiar behavioral habit
His most endearing quirk was his habit of humming when he was deep in thought.

a person who makes changes to something in order to improve it
She was a passionate reformer, advocating for social justice.

a person who makes money by using dishonest methods
Be careful of online scammers trying to steal your information.

the feeling or belief that someone or something is worthless or despicable
He looked at her with scorn after her betrayal.

a person or company that transports goods
The shipper ensured the package arrived on time.

a musical composition
Beethoven's 'Moonlight Sonata' is very famous.

a sudden, panicked rush of a large group of animals or people
The loud noise caused a stampede of cattle.

a deadlock or stalemate
The negotiations ended in a standoff.

an uncontrolled outburst of anger and frustration
The child threw a tantrum when he didn't get his toy.

the transfer of blood or blood components
The patient needed a blood transfusion.

the audience for a television program or channel
The show's viewership increased significantly.

a person who is very good at something
She's a real computer wiz.

a noisy argument or disagreement
There was a minor altercation between the two drivers.

the process of increasing the volume or intensity of sound
The amplification of the sound made the music much clearer.

a fleet of warships
The Spanish Armada was defeated in 1588.

creative skill or ability
Her piano playing showed great artistry.

a large open space, often with a glass roof, in the center of a modern building
The hotel had a beautiful atrium with a fountain.

the act of writing or printing in capital letters; the total value of a company's shares
Proper capitalization is important in writing.

a fine, soft wool
She wore a soft cashmere sweater.

the process of a gas changing to a liquid
There was a lot of condensation on the windows.

difficulty emptying the bowels
He suffered from occasional constipation.

a person who has custody of something
The school custodian cleaned the hallways every night.

a sac-like growth
The doctor said the cyst was benign.

the way a person moves their feet
His excellent footwork helped him win the boxing match.

food (informal); the larva of an insect
Let's get some grub after the game.

a place where someone spends a lot of time
The coffee shop is our favorite hangout.

a type of tree or its strong, hard wood
The furniture was made of solid hickory.

a large piece; an attractive man (informal)
He cut a large hunk of bread.

a name or number that identifies someone or something
Each product has a unique identifier.

a deep, wide ditch, typically filled with water, surrounding a castle, town, or fortress for defense
The castle was protected by a wide moat.

the part of a telephone, musical instrument, or other device that is placed in or against the mouth
The trumpet's mouthpiece was made of brass.

dirt, filth, or waste matter
His boots were covered in muck from the muddy field.

an event regarded as a portent of good or evil
The black cat crossing their path was considered a bad omen.

a portable platform on which goods can be moved, stacked, and stored
The boxes were stacked on a wooden pallet.

a chemical treatment that makes hair curly or wavy
She decided to get a perm to add volume to her hair.

a type of bean with mottled skin
She cooked a delicious chili with pinto beans.

Something that indicates what will happen in the future.
High school grades are often a good predictor of college success.

The people who read a particular newspaper, magazine, or book.
The magazine has a large and loyal readership.

A fee paid in advance to secure services; a loyal servant or follower.
The lawyer asked for a substantial retainer before starting the case.

A person who supports the separation of a particular group of people from a larger body on the basis of ethnicity, religion, or gender.
The region has a history of separatist movements.

A small piece or brief extract.
I only heard a snippet of their conversation.

A woman who is chosen to speak officially for a group or organization.
The spokeswoman announced the company's new policy.

A large accumulation of something for future use.
The country built up a stockpile of emergency supplies.

An additional charge or payment.
There is a small surcharge for using a credit card.

A pack of cards, used for fortune-telling.
She used tarot cards to predict the future.

A rare metallic element, used in light bulb filaments.
Tungsten is known for its high melting point.

acceptance of the truth or existence of something
He received an acknowledgment of his application.

deep love and respect
The fans showed their adoration for the band.

A person who takes part in a conspiracy
The police arrested the main conspirator in the plot.

Lack of bravery
His actions were motivated by fear and cowardice.

A machine that crushes rock or other materials
The stone crusher processed tons of gravel every day.

A dish made of lentils or other pulses
We had a delicious bowl of lentil dahl for dinner.

The action of disqualifying or the state of being disqualified
His disqualification from the race was due to a false start.

a sudden, brief fall of snow; a sudden burst of activity
There was a sudden flurry of snow this morning.

a faint, wavering light; a faint sign of something
There was a glimmer of hope in her eyes.

a small valley or ravine, especially one eroded by water
The rainwater carved a deep gully in the hillside.

a three-dimensional image formed by interference of light beams
The concert featured a hologram of the deceased singer.
